scope: Provider-neutral candidate hardware-attestation evidence for an execution observation; optional, never a base-contract prerequisite.
required_checks: Verify the native attestation document against deployment-selected attestation trust roots, preserving the native format and verifier version.
Match the workload measurement to an explicit deployment-approved workload/build identity; a measurement string alone is insufficient.
Validate an unpredictable one-use verifier challenge and its bounded appraisal time window; an operator-selected nonce alone is insufficient.
Require an affirming appraisal from an explicitly selected verifier.
Bind the document and appraisal to the same observation, workload and pre-dispatch execution-context digest; signing an observation afterwards is insufficient.

claims.claim_ceiling: A validated native quote and execution binding may support execution of the measured workload inside the declared hardware boundary; neither an operator signature nor schema validation establishes this.
The attested measurement identifies a deployment-approved workload, not application correctness or initiating-model authenticity beyond the measured and bound context.
A selected verifier validates a one-use challenge and bounded appraisal window; wall-clock fields and a matching nonce string do not establish freshness by themselves.

explicit_non_claims: complete mediation or runtime capability-surface completeness
downstream effect correctness or provider idempotency
Federation admission, production safety or execution authority
provider_policy: Providers and verifier profiles are deployment-selected data, not hardcoded vendor conditions. No Nitro, SEV-SNP or TDX verifier is integrated here.
verification_boundary: The schema represents provider-reported candidate claims. Native cryptographic attestation verification and hardware runs are not implemented; local_verification remains NOT_EVALUATED.
